info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Limits-v1-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Limits API provides access to the limits associated with credit card applications. This endpoint allows users to retrieve current limit information, which is essential for assessing application feasibility and determining eligible offerings. Typical consumers include financial institutions, credit analysts, and application processing systems looking to ensure compliance and optimize risk management. Through this API, developers can integrate limit retrieval functionality into their applications for better decision-making and services.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current limit set for applications in the system. It provides essential information regarding how many applications can be processed or created within the defined parameters.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving application limit information. This endpoint expects a JSON object that specifies the criteria for fetching the limit details.

204.description: The request has been successfully processed, but there's no content to return.
